theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (V C Y : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (w : Euclid P → ℝ) (W : Euclid P → Euclid P) (c' : ℝ), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → IsCompact C → C ⊆ V → MeasurableSet Y → Y ⊆ C → IntegrableOn w (ψ '' Y) μHE[d] → Measurable W → (∀ x, ‖W x‖ ≤ c') → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[d].restrict (ψ '' Y)), ∀ y ∈ Y, ψ y = x → W x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid d →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) → ∃ Φ : Euclid d → Euclid d, Integrable Φ ∧ (∀ y, y ∉ Y → Φ y = 0) ∧ ∀ (β : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (α : Euclid d → (Euclid d →L[ℝ] ℝ)), (∀ y ∈ Y, (β (ψ y)).comp (fderiv ℝ ψ y) = α y) → ∫ x in ψ '' Y, w x * β x (W x) ∂μHE[d] = ∫ y, α y (Φ y)
